relative_volume_lookback.prior_003b_text: mean(opening_range_volume(D-k, j)) over k=1..14 completed eligible sessions for j
relative_volume_lookback.corrected_003c_rule: The denominator must use exactly the immediately preceding 14 completed regular trading sessions for the symbol. It does NOT condition on passing the $5 price filter, passing ADV, passing ATR, RV >= 1, being Top 20, or generating a trade.
relative_volume_lookback.exact_xnys_session_requirement: The 14 lookback sessions must be exactly the immediately preceding 14 completed XNYS regular trading sessions (D-1 down through D-14). Gaps, missing sessions, or duplicate sessions fail closed. Older sessions may not replace missing sessions. Observation model: OpeningRangeVolumeObservation(symbol, session_date, volume).
relative_volume_lookback.missing_session_behavior: FAIL_CLOSED: If any required prior opening-range observation in the preceding 14 completed sessions is missing, the symbol's RV is non-computable. Do not silently search further backward for 14 eligible sessions.
relative_volume_lookback.pre_data_access_audit: No empirical market data has been accessed for DAYTRADE-003 before this correction.

formula.true_range: TR_t = max(high_t - low_t, abs(high_t - close_{t-1}), abs(low_t - close_{t-1}))
formula.initial_atr14: arithmetic mean of the first 14 True Range observations (requires 15 daily sessions)

amb_02_atr.evaluation_session_boundary: For session D, the strategy may use only the ATR available through D-1. Session D prices must never enter its own ATR.
amb_02_atr.history_requirement: Evaluator requires a contiguous sequence of completed XNYS trading sessions ending at D-1 with a minimum of 15 daily sessions to produce 14 True Range values. Missing XNYS sessions or duplicates in the sequence fail closed.

amb_03_position_sizing_and_portfolio_lev.topic: Position Sizing and Portfolio Leverage Cap
amb_03_position_sizing_and_portfolio_lev.account_equity_basis: session_start_equity (A) for all 1% risk calculations and leverage ceiling during the session; intraday unrealized gains do not expand capacity; compounding occurs at session close: next_session_equity = session_start_equity + net_daily_PnL
amb_03_position_sizing_and_portfolio_lev.order_rejection_conditions: Reject if R <= 0, P <= 0, or desired_shares <= 0
amb_03_position_sizing_and_portfolio_lev.capacity_rejection_action: If actual_shares <= 0, record CAPACITY_REJECTED. No fractional shares.
amb_03_position_sizing_and_portfolio_lev.capacity_recycling_rules: When an existing position closes, its gross notional capacity becomes available for later timestamps. For a position opened and stopped within the SAME one-minute bar, do not recycle its capacity within that same timestamp; release capacity beginning with the next minute.

amb_09_commission_structure.round_trip_formula: 2 * shares * 0.0035 (one entry fill and one exit fill = 0.0070 per share round-trip)
amb_09_commission_structure.justification: Primary paper reports $0.0035/share per side and does not specify broker ticket minimums. Slippage scenarios B (2 bps) and C (5 bps) provide preregistered economic hurdles.

amb_10_corporate_action_price_basis.topic: Corporate Action and Price Basis Consistency
amb_10_corporate_action_price_basis.justification: Preserves point-in-time correctness, matches IQFeed unadjusted intraday convention in primary paper, and avoids mixing adjusted daily prices with raw intraday prices. Potential source-implementation difference disclosed.

amb_01_universe_semantics.target_universe_definition: All point-in-time provider records in the stock/equity market whose primary exchange is NYSE or Nasdaq and which are active on the queried historical session date, including securities later delisted.
amb_01_universe_semantics.metadata_audit_requirement: Preserve provider type and security classification codes in metadata for auditability.

early_close_sessions.enforcement: Evaluated at evaluate_session entry via tradex.market.hours.get_market_session. Early-close sessions return EXCLUDED_EARLY_CLOSE and are excluded from formal evaluation return series.
early_close_sessions.justification: The primary paper defines liquidation at 4:00 PM ET and does not specify early-close handling. Excluding XNYS early-close sessions avoids silently altering holding horizons. Record exclusion deterministically.

amb_06_gap_through_fills.long_stop_entry: If bar.open >= P fill at bar.open; else if bar.high >= P fill at P; else no fill
amb_06_gap_through_fills.short_stop_entry: If bar.open <= P fill at bar.open; else if bar.low <= P fill at P; else no fill
amb_06_gap_through_fills.long_protective_stop: If bar.open <= stop fill at bar.open; else if bar.low <= stop fill at stop; else open
amb_06_gap_through_fills.short_protective_stop: If bar.open >= stop fill at bar.open; else if bar.high >= stop fill at stop; else open

amb_07_same_bar_entry_and_stop.topic: Same-Bar Entry and Stop Path Collision
amb_07_same_bar_entry_and_stop.rule: If a 1-minute bar triggers entry and touches the protective stop in the same bar and intrabar path cannot be proven, conservatively assume entry occurred and the stop was triggered (worst-case fail closed).

turnover_metric_definition.formula: session_traded_notional = sum(abs(shares * raw_entry_price) + abs(shares * raw_exit_price) for trade in completed_trades); session_turnover = session_traded_notional / session_start_equity
turnover_metric_definition.study_daily_turnover: mean(session_turnover across valid included full sessions). Valid zero-trade day contributes 0.0.
turnover_metric_definition.distinction_from_leverage: max_leverage_used remains tracked separately as maximum observed gross exposure divided by session equity.

candidate_ranking_and_selection.doji_selection_rule: Top-20 selection occurs strictly prior to knowing if stop entry triggers. If a selected symbol is a doji (OR_open == OR_close), it produces NO_ORDER. There is NO BACKFILL from rank 21.
candidate_ranking_and_selection.candidate_pool_completeness_gate: For every active PIT universe member, all required Stage-A data (exact ADV14, contiguous ATR14, exact RV14 observations, 5 opening range minutes) must be present and verified. If any active member has missing, corrupted, or non-computable Stage-A data, the session fails closed as non_computable. Normal technical filter failures (price <= $5, ADV < 1M, ATR <= 0.50, RV < 1.0) produce normal non-qualification.

stage_a_candidate_construction.description: Acquire data needed to rank candidates and select Top 20 at 09:35

stage_b_trade_path.description: Acquire full regular-session 1-minute bars strictly for that session's selected Top-20 symbols
stage_b_trade_path.lookahead_free_guarantee: Stage-B symbols determined solely from Stage-A information available at 09:35
stage_b_trade_path.state_aware_path_requirement: Simulator iterates canonical XNYS minute sequence (09:35 to 15:59 ET). Symbols with active pending orders or open positions require bars at every expected minute. Missing required bar fails the session closed as non_computable. Symbols in completed/dead state (stopped out, EOD liquidated, capacity rejected, NO_ORDER_DOJI) do not require future bars. Open positions at 15:59 require the 15:59 bar. Bar integrity rejects duplicate timestamps, date mismatches, symbol mismatches, or malformed OHLCV.

scenario_a_source_comparison.commission_application: Applied on both entry and exit: $0.0035 per share per side ($0.0070 round-trip).

scenario_b_tradex_primary.commission_application: Applied on both entry and exit: $0.0035 per share per side ($0.0070 round-trip).
scenario_b_tradex_primary.purpose: Primary research and decision gate evaluation

scenario_c_stress.commission_application: Applied on both entry and exit: $0.0035 per share per side ($0.0070 round-trip).

transaction_costs_and_scenarios.strategy_path_independence: Execution trigger times, filled shares, stop triggers, and exit prices are identical across all scenarios. Slippage is modeled as monetary friction deducted from PnL.

metrics_and_bootstrap_contract.daily_return_series_rule: Every valid included regular trading session enters the daily return series. Valid sessions with zero trades contribute exactly 0.0 daily portfolio return.
metrics_and_bootstrap_contract.session_distinction: Valid full sessions with zero trades contribute 0.0 daily return and 0.0 turnover and enter bootstrap. Non-computable / integrity-failed sessions never masquerade as zero return and do not enter bootstrap. Early-close sessions are excluded from formal series.
metrics_and_bootstrap_contract.required_session_noncomputability_dispos: Conservative fail-closed rule: If any otherwise-required full regular session is non-computable because of material candidate-pool or execution-path integrity failure, formal study disposition is INVALID. Bootstrap fails closed.

validation_disposition_precedence.condition: Material data-integrity, point-in-time, or execution failure
Evidence sufficiency failure: < 100 regular sessions with candidates, < 500 triggered trades, or < 50 unique securities traded
Mean daily Scenario-B net return > 0.0 but 95% bootstrap CI lower bound <= 0.0
All gates pass: mean daily Scenario-B net return > 0.0 and 95% bootstrap CI lower bound > 0.0

holdout_access_guard.action_when_not_supported: REJECT_ACCESS: Holdout partition remains strictly unopened and unread
